title: Replace Hono dashboard routing with Bun.serve
description: Replace Hono in src/dashboard/server.ts with a typed direct Bun.serve dispatcher after task-bun-native-dashboard-build. Preserve originGuard, json, catchDiag, SSE publishing, static asset serving, SPA fallback, and every existing route: /api/status; /api/tasks and /api/tasks/:id including brief, claim, release, finish, status, reopen; /api/issues and close; /api/gh/import/export; /api/messages and inbox; /api/prompts and render; /api/handoffs; /api/claims; /api/validate; /api/git/status, context, diff, commit; /api/reindex; /api/events; /graphify-out/*; /assets/*; /favicon.ico; / and wildcard fallback.
acceptance: Dashboard API and SSE tests pass unchanged or are strengthened to assert parity for every existing route.
Static assets, SPA fallback, headers, status codes, and CommandResult response envelopes match the current dashboard contract.
Hono is removed from package.json and bun.lock only after source and compiled dashboard smoke tests pass.
Bun 1.4 frozen install, tests, typecheck, Biome, build, and ledger validation pass.
notes: Execution inventory: src/dashboard/server.ts currently contains the Hono app and route contract; dashboard tests exercise API JSON envelopes, diagnostics, SSE, static serving, and compiled assets. Preserve Request/Response compatibility for tests or replace the test client without reducing coverage. All mutations continue through src/core. See docs/bun-native-stack-migration-plan.md.
